Key findings

  • Net debt / EBITDA of 4.6x uses 77% of the 6.0x limit; EBITDA can fall 23.3% to 290 before it is breached.
  • EBITDA / cash interest of 2.7x uses 74% of the limit; EBITDA can fall 25.9% to 280 before the 2.0x floor is breached.
  • Headroom on both tests is lower than at FY2025 (25.0% and 31.5%).
  • The restricted payments basket is 85% used, with 18 of 120 remaining.

Contrary evidence and what would change the view

  • Net debt rose to 1,739 from 1,656 while EBITDA rose only to 378 from 368, so room narrowed even as earnings grew.
  • The revolver drawn 50 and other debt of 100 both fall due in 2027, which would test liquidity before the leverage limit.
  • A fall in EBITDA of more than 23.3% would change the view.
